channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Türkiye offers facilitator role in Iran-US tension
item.description: Türkiye has formally proposed to play a facilitating role in the de-escalation of ongoing tension between Iran and the United States during high-level talks between Turkish and Iranian officials in Istanbul, reiterating diplomacy and dialogue is the best way to resolve standing disputes.

item.title: A brand story from home kitchen to world
item.description: Founded by Lebanese entrepreneur Mireille Hayek, Em Sherif’s story traces how a home-kitchen tradition evolved into a global gastronomic brand by turning memory, adaptability and female leadership into its strongest ingredients

item.title: Turkish schools to resume education with flag awareness week
item.description: The Education Ministry has announced that the second term of the 2025-2026 academic year will begin with a nationwide initiative themed around love for the flag, aimed at strengthening unity and shared sense ıf belonging among students.

item.title: Trump picks former US Fed official as next central bank chief
item.description: President Donald Trump said Friday he would nominate former Federal Reserve governor Kevin Warsh to be the next US central bank chief, a move that has sparked cautious optimism among observers.

item.title: Türkiye’s Somalia footprint grows amid Horn of Africa tensions
item.description: Türkiye has deployed three F-16 Fighting Falcon fighter jets to Mogadishu, Middle East Eye reported, as Ankara deepens its security role in Somalia amid fresh regional strains.

item.title: Epstein survivors say abusers 'remain hidden' after latest files release
item.description: Survivors of Jeffrey Epstein said their alleged abusers "remain hidden and protected" after the U.S. government released millions of new pages from files related to the convicted sex offender on Friday, adding fuel to the case that has dogged President Donald Trump.

item.title: Damascus sets Monday start for SDF integration agreement
item.description: Syria’s information minister Hamza al-Mustafa said Friday that a ceasefire and integration agreement with the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) will take effect on Monday, calling it a step toward consolidating state authority and easing tensions in the northeast.

item.title: Iran FM warns on US pressure, welcomes Erdoğan’s diplomacy push
item.description: Iran’s top diplomat Abbas Araghchi said Türkiye has taken a “constructive” approach toward Tehran and is working to find a diplomatic way to ease tensions with the United States, as Ankara renews its offer to help mediate.

item.title: Türkiye criticizes UN renewal of Cyprus peacekeeping mandate
item.description: Türkiye on Jan. 31 criticized a United Nations Security Council decision extending the mandate of the United Nations Peacekeeping Force in Cyprus (UNFICYP) for another year, arguing the move again failed to secure the consent of the Turkish Cypriot side.

item.title: Trump expects Iran to seek deal to avoid US strikes
item.description: President Donald Trump predicted on Friday that Iran would seek to negotiate a deal rather than face American military action, despite Tehran warning that its arsenal of missiles would never be up for discussion.
